cards.title: WHO Congress Advances One Health
cards.content: The Quadripartite partners including FAO, UNEP, WHO and WOAH, highlighted a shared focus on implementation, science and investment at the 9th World One Health Congress in Lisbon, Portugal from 4 to 7 September 2026. The partners explored how stronger country implementation, scientific evidence and investment can help realize tangible One Health outcomes. A key focus was implementation of the One Health Joint Plan of Action at country level. The One Health High-Level Expert Panel presented its 10 recommendations addressing barriers, strengthening enabling conditions and advancing implementation. The partners also highlighted the importance of science and evidence in guiding One Health action. Investment and financing formed a key strand of Quadripartite engagement, with sessions exploring how to build the investment case for One Health, demonstrate return on investment and identify opportunities to mobilize resources. The 9th World One Health Congress brought together over 1300 participants from around the world to advance One Health science, policy and practice. The Quadripartite Secretariat for One Health launched a guide to implementing the One Health Joint Plan of Action at national level. The Quadripartite Joint Offer: A call for targeted One Health investment was also launched
